blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Businesses and taxpayers here could get more time to prepare for proposed increases in local taxes and fees after the City Council approved a motion seeking a one-year deferment of the passage and implementation of the proposed 2026 Local Revenue Code. The council approved an omnibus motion from Councilor Joel Garganera during its session on Wednesday, November 25, directing the proposed measure back to the Committee on Budget and Finance, in coordination with the Committee on Laws, for further stakeholder consultations and a comprehensive assessment of its economic impact.
